title: Jacobian minors of Lipschitz maps are measurable and bounded by r!(L·Σ|V_b|)^r
statement: Let k, r ∈ ℕ, L ∈ ℝ≥0, g_0, …, g_{r−1} : ℝᵏ → ℝ L-Lipschitz (ℝᵏ = Euclid k) and V_0, …, V_{r−1} ∈ ℝᵏ. Let D(x) := det(Dg_c(x)V_b)_{c,b ∈ Fin r}, where Dg(x) := fderiv ℝ g x (the zero map where g is not differentiable). Then x ↦ D(x) is measurable and |D(x)| ≤ r!·(L·Σ_b ‖V_b‖)^r for every x ∈ ℝᵏ.
lean_statement: ∀ (k r : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (g : Fin r → Euclid k → ℝ) (V : Fin r → Euclid k), (∀ c, LipschitzWith L (g c)) → Measurable (fun x => Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun c b => fderiv ℝ (g c) x (V b))) ∧ ∀ x, |Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun c b => fderiv ℝ (g c) x (V b))| ≤ (r.factorial : ℝ) * ((L : ℝ) * ∑ b, ‖V b‖) ^ r
